Classic Shell compromised on FossHub

Target: Classic Shell
Repository: https://github.com/coddec/Classic-Shell
Date: 2016-08-02 to 2016-08-03 (1 day)
Attribution: Individual Hacker
Component: Application
Language: C++
Cause: Compromised Infrastructure
Motive: Disruption/Protest
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Service Disruption, Data Destruction
User Impact: 10000
Domain: fosshub.com (package host)
Artifact Type: binary archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

FossHub's distribution platform was compromised, and Classic Shell downloads were swapped for a destructive installer. Users who trusted the official download path received code that rewrote the master boot record, collapsing a familiar Windows utility into a boot-failure payload delivered through the software mirror.
